1.consolidated_definition: Pez de agua salada y dulce, de hasta 23 cm de longitud, de cuerpo fusiforme y comprimido de color gris plateado, boca pequeña y aletas radiales. (Gerreidae, Eucinostomus gula).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Fish of brackish and saltwater, up to 9 inches in length, with a fusiform and compressed body of silvery gray color, small mouth, and radial fins (Gerreidae, Eucinostomus gula).
